items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: I, I never knew him well at all. I'd met him.

ctx.x: I think I knew him. And the Benson Orchestra, if you remember, had, uh, Roy Bargy in it. And, uh, a couple saxophone players that ended up with White Man.
Of course you got to know Valle Defoe.
I, I never knew him well at all. I'd met him.
